lines.t: I wake up thankful but my heart feels numb
Got prayers on my lips but my mind still runs
I know you're good, yeah, I know it's true
But some days it's hard to feel close to you
I read the word but the weight stays heavy
Faith feels strong, but my soul ain't steady I don't wanna fake joy, I don't feel inside
I just wanna be honest when I talk to Yahushua You see the cracks I try to hide
You hear the prayers I can verbalize
Yahushua, I'm tryna be happy But I'm learning joy ain't just a feeling
Even when my heart feels empty, you're still here, you're still healing
I don't need a perfect life, I just need your peace tonight
Teach me how to trust you fully, even when I don't feel alive
Faith don't mean that the pain just goes
Sometimes it's walking when the road feels closed
I talk to you in the dead of the night
Tell you my fears, tell you I'm tired of the fight
You never said it would all be easy
You promised you'd never leave me
So I hold on when my hope feels thin
Cause grace still works when I'm weak within
Joy is deeper than a smile on my face
Implanted in me by your grace
I'll wait for the day my heart can see
That you've been working quietly
Yeah, I'm sure I'm learning what happiness means
It's not the absence of pain in me
It's knowing you're close when I fall apart
It's trusting you with my broken heart
I don't need everything to be okay
I just need you to lead the way
Thank you.
